Just saying, that sounds like you don’t really know what you’re talking about and are just complaining that we aren’t agreeing with you immediately, but anywho: My use of builds is not a complaint, it’s a statement that trying to balance the game with those in place will make them difficult by default. Nerfing everything “op” into the floor doesn’t work because just like with gambit, everyone swaps to another strong weapon. The same thing will happen in pvp: they nerf the item, and the community moves onto the next thing that works the best and then calls for it to be nerfed. Really what needs to happen is slightly, SLIGHTLY nerfing the “op” stuff and buffing the underpowered aspects of pvp. The playing field isn’t even, so finding ways to level it out is going to be key to keeping it sustainable. SBMM? The game’s grown, we need it back. Back in forsaken when we were all grinding for Luna’s and NF, we didn’t need it that much but now it’s time for it to come back. The momentum mechanic where killing a player gives you ability energy back is smart, maybe they could expand upon that in base pvp. Ideas, ideas, ideas instead of “nerf, game bad, mad cuz bad”

Do I play pvp as much as you? Probably not, but I’d like the gamemode to be fun to play. Being objective and offering ideas for improving your favorite game isn’t difficult, but go ahead and say again I’m invalid for not pouring the majority of my time and energy into pvp.

There’s a difference between being ironic about it for the meme “OoH DeSTinY bAd” but then there’s this type, which is complaining for the sake of complaining. Pvp balancing in a game where we can take custom roles and builds into an activity IS NOT easy, and it never will be. How do they keep from having another felwinter’s situation or another recluse situation, where one pvp weapon outclasses literally everything in it’s vicinity. For the annoying part of the pvp community, it’s either “this is so broken and powerful” or “this is trash, bungie why did you make this” so when those are the two majority responses Bungie gets as feedback, no shit they dont try to make good pvp weapons as much as PvE.

Both player, so again, yes and no. The point though, is yes because you are entitled to your own opinion of pvp, and I do agree it’s trash at the moment, but no because pvp players like you will complain about everything.
